value.answer: Call 911 now, or go to the ER immediately - a fever with a rash that stays purple/does not fade when you press a glass against it can mean a serious infection needing urgent treatment.
value.triage: Do not wait or call 811 for this - go straight to the ER or call 911 now. If breathing looks fast/laboured, lips look dusky, or the child becomes very sleepy or hard to wake, that is 911 immediately.
